## Projects

### Model Averaging in Policy Learning

May 2026 – Now

- Develop model averaging methods under some criterions in the field of policy learning with or without unconfoundedness assumption.  
            

### Data Combination in Causal Inference

May 2025 - Aug 2026

- Develop efficient estimators for the difference of CATEs between an observational study and a randomized trial, with unobserved confounders appearing in the observational study.
- Tools used: semiparametric inference, M-estimators, empirical processes, sensitivity analysis.

### Alpha Factor Mining With LLMs

Apr 2026 - Jun 2026

- Surveyed this field and reproduced two papers.
- Based on the reproduction results, plan to propose new algorithms in the coming months.

### Homotopy Theory in Complex Geometry

Nov 2023 - May 2024

- Undergraduate dissertation supervised by Prof. Songyan Xie.
- Surveyed model category structure and Oka theory.
